text.en:
Upon the recommendation of the Provincial Board of
Isabela and pursuant to the provisions of section 68 of the
Revised Administrative Code, the seat of government of
the municipality of San Pablo, Isabela, is hereby returned
from the barrio of Auitan where it was transferred by
Executive Order No. 109, series of 1946, io the old pobla-
cion or Centro of said municipality.
This transfer shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of June, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-three,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the seventh.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philimmines
By the President:
MArCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
